title: InstaFlow: One Step is Enough for High-Quality Diffusion-Based Text-to-Image Generation
tldr_zh: 文本条件 reflow 理顺 SD 噪声-图像耦合后蒸馏，首个 SD 级一步文生图：COCO-5k FID 23.4，199 A100 天
tldr_en: Text-conditioned reflow refines Stable Diffusion's noise-image coupling so one-step distillation works: COCO-5k FID 23.4 in 0.09s, 199 A100 GPU days.
key_numbers: InstaFlow-0.9B one-step FID-5k 23.4 / CLIP 0.304 on MS COCO 2017, 0.09s (Table 2a)
